rationale: Channel breakout is the classic turtle-style trend rule; it enters later but holds winners longer than the moving-average ensemble.
Slower breakout for multi-month trends; fewer trades, lower costs.
The low-volatility anomaly is one of the most persistent equity factors; in crypto, the wildest alts tend to underperform after costs.
Momentum measured after removing each coin's BTC beta isolates coin-specific strength and may be less exposed to market crashes.
Shorter-horizon cross-sectional momentum (4 to 8 days) to test whether the momentum edge extends to faster signals.
Slower trend ensemble (1 to 4 months) that trades less and may diversify the current trend sleeve.
Top and bottom 10% only: a stronger but noisier momentum signal.
